name: Tiny Emu 73
author: csemszepp
description: Neon pill sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #6E6E6E to #1849AB, transform becomes translateX(26px). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 4px #159ce4, the outline is removed.
